results.evidence: IntegrationOwnerSecurityContractTest and IntegrationApiContractTest pin the exact twenty closed owner operations, trusted Gateway authority, Problem/receipt behavior and rejection of browser-supplied tenant authority; integration-control-plane-client.test.ts covers the same four reads and sixteen commands.

IntegrationCursorOwnerQueryTest and the preserved Sys008ProjectionContractTest prove one owner query with two policy projections, stable itemPublicId and EFFECTIVE_STATUS revision, and non-serialized owner lineage; no second owner repository or completion credit is added.

IntegrationCursorOwnerQueryTest and IntegrationServiceTest bind the cursor to all eleven query axes, enforce projection-specific fields, filters, eight sealed sorts, limits 1 through 100, stable ordering and freshness; frontend model and client tests cover COMPLETE, EMPTY, PARTIAL and UNAVAILABLE handling.

IntegrationOwnerAuthorityFilter, IntegrationOwnerQueryService and their security/query tests apply trusted authority, scope, purpose, field policy and item eligibility before serialization; preserved projection tests plus frontend model tests prove VIEW, MASK and OMIT handling and zero client-inferred actions.

IntegrationDomainPolicyTest, IntegrationServiceTest and IntegrationRequiredDatabaseEvidenceTest cover immutable connector and mapping versions, validation/test or dry-run evidence, submit/approve/activate lifecycle, separate actors, current digests and expected-revision CAS.

IntegrationDomainPolicyTest rejects the same actor or overlapping population for maker/checker duties, IntegrationOwnerSecurityContractTest binds legal-entity population to trusted Gateway facts, and PostgreSQL direct-write evidence preserves the same separation.

The preserved Sys008OpaqueReferenceOwnerPortTest and Sys008EgressBoundary contract reject private, metadata, query-secret, redirect and DNS-rebinding targets and cross-boundary reference substitution; IntegrationServiceTest validates canonical endpoints only after allowlist resolution and no production provider is bound.

IntegrationServiceTest freezes the canonical multi-item source manifest and definition/mapping boundaries at receipt-first acceptance; JdbcIntegrationRepositoryPostgresTest proves atomic receipt, execution, initial item and attempt persistence, provider-key replay conflict and monotonic CAS/fence behavior.

IntegrationRuntimeServiceTest persists ambiguous or mismatched provider outcomes as RESULT_UNKNOWN, reconciles under a separate command receipt using the frozen original provider key and digest, and never recalls or blindly redispatches the provider; PostgreSQL evidence covers the same terminal receipt rule.

IntegrationDomainPolicyTest and IntegrationRuntimeServiceTest enforce the exact frozen retryable failed-item set, new attempts without remapping successful items, direct pre-dispatch cancellation, durable compensation claims and separately keyed post-dispatch compensation.

The preserved Sys008EventContractTest validates the closed SYS-EVT-005 payload and forbidden fields; IntegrationRequiredDatabaseEvidenceTest proves execution CAS, audit and event outbox rollback atomically, while deterministic event identity and public counts/digest exclude secrets, raw payload and employee identity.

V334 SHA-256 d4c3750ade0e6925378c8a8aa5093605891d5afe01b91e926c6485afb2f092d4 creates exactly six tenant-composite FORCE-RLS tables. IntegrationMigrationPostgresTest, IntegrationRequiredDatabaseEvidenceTest and JdbcIntegrationRepositoryPostgresTest cover clean and V333 upgrade paths, RLS/ACL, composite integrity, lifecycle and terminal guards, immutable snapshots, stale fences, provider-key uniqueness, compensation bypass, forbidden columns and SYS-006 receipt compatibility.

The preserved integration-control-plane surface plus the new model, client and workbench implement one owner truth for HRIS Settings and DWP Control projections, keep HCM deep-link ownership unchanged, separate read and command errors and expose zero commands for partial, masked, stale, unavailable or denied evidence.

The four targeted Vitest files passed 74 of 74 tests. jsdom and sealed contract assertions verify named controls, keyboard-focusable selection, screen-reader labels, no nested main landmark, flexible-width rules and declared viewport/zoom metadata. Source inspection confirms theme-token use and forced-colors/reduced-motion media rules are implemented; mode-specific browser rendering, visual appearance and overflow execution are not claimed.

IntegrationApiContractTest and the preserved unmounted surface contract keep HRIS_INTEGRATION_CONTROL_PLANE default OFF with no runtime scheduler or owner call; no route, sidebar, menu, shell, index export, tenant enrollment or production provider binding changed.

goldenScenarios.evidence: IntegrationRequiredDatabaseEvidenceTest exercises missing-context and cross-tenant denial for every owned table under the runtime role, and IntegrationOwnerSecurityContractTest returns a bounded denial for untrusted tenant or widened legal-entity scope.

IntegrationDomainPolicyTest rejects same-actor and overlapping maker/checker populations while allowing separately scoped actors; lifecycle commands also require current target-bound authority and CAS.

IntegrationApiContractTest rejects literal secrets and unknown command properties; the preserved opaque-reference contract accepts only sealed references, and V334 forbidden-column scans prove literal secret or token material has no persistence column.

Sys008OpaqueReferenceOwnerPortTest denies private and metadata addresses, query secrets, redirects and DNS rebinding before provider dispatch; IntegrationServiceTest requires a canonical allowlisted endpoint and no production provider is bound.

IntegrationServiceTest keeps connection-test and mapping dry-run evidence separate from production execution, validates all frozen definition/mapping boundaries and passes only typed opaque artifacts; no production provider or domain owner is registered.

IntegrationRuntimeServiceTest records a timeout or unbound response as durable RESULT_UNKNOWN and requires same-key reconciliation evidence; stale recovery records an operations exception and never invokes the provider again.

IntegrationRuntimeServiceTest and IntegrationRequiredDatabaseEvidenceTest bind PARTIAL/reconciliation counts and digest to the exact frozen item set and create new attempts only for retryable rejected identities.

The previously admitted SYS-006 proof in r7-batch-04-module-results-r1/base-tfr-sys-006/acceptance-results.v1.json remains the production inbox dedupe and highest-revision owner evidence; V334 does not modify sys_domain_event_inbox, and the clean plus V333-to-V334 PostgreSQL upgrade preserves shared-store evidence without recounting it as SYS-008 work.

JdbcIntegrationRepositoryPostgresTest proves receipt authorization precedes digest disclosure and IntegrationOwnerSecurityContractTest rechecks trusted current tenant, subject, scope, purpose and revision so revoked, cross-tenant or caller-widened lookup fails closed.

JdbcIntegrationRepositoryPostgresTest proves same-subject same-digest replay, changed-digest conflict and initial ledger atomicity; V334 limits immutable terminal receipt rules to the exact sixteen SYS-008 actions while retaining sealed subject/action/key/digest binding.

IntegrationServiceTest, IntegrationDomainPolicyTest and PostgreSQL lifecycle negatives require current definition, mapping, endpoint-policy, secret and schema evidence plus distinct author/approver/executor identities before activation; self-approval and snapshot drift fail closed.

IntegrationRuntimeServiceTest reconciles RESULT_UNKNOWN only from digest-bound evidence using the original provider idempotency key; mismatched counts or digest stay unknown and Sys008OperationsExceptionOutboxAdapter emits the sealed operational exception without redispatch.

IntegrationDomainPolicyTest, IntegrationRuntimeServiceTest and database transition negatives prove failed-only retry, new attempts with unchanged mapping/source identity, preservation of successful items, pre-dispatch cancel and explicit post-dispatch compensation.
